strings.loc.dlg.ch01.mira.arrive.1: That channel's been dry since before I was born. Did you—?
strings.loc.dlg.ch01.mira.arrive.2: You touched it and it answered? It doesn't answer me. It doesn't answer anyone.
strings.loc.dlg.ch01.mira.arrive.3: I'm Mira. I map what changes. Lately nothing does. Until now, apparently.
strings.loc.dlg.ch01.mira.path.1: Two nodes. I've only ever seen one wake at a time — if they wake at all.
strings.loc.dlg.ch01.mira.path.2: Try the near one. I'll watch what happens to the far one.
strings.loc.dlg.ch01.mira.radiate.1: It woke the other one. They're… connected. I never had that on a map.
strings.loc.dlg.ch01.orin.threshold.1: I have waited a long time to hear that sound again.
strings.loc.dlg.ch01.orin.threshold.2: The Loom is waking. We can put the world back the way it was.
strings.loc.dlg.ch01.orin.threshold.3: Everything in its place. Every path where it belonged.
strings.loc.dlg.ch01.orin.threshold.4: Come. There is a great deal to restore.
strings.loc.item.archive_thread.lore: A strand the Loom shed as it changed. Someone kept it. It remembers only part of what happened.
strings.loc.item.archive_thread.name: Archive Thread
strings.loc.item.echo_compass.lore: The needle points to difference, not north. The Grid's engineers used it to check a sequence against its record.
strings.loc.item.echo_compass.name: Echo Compass
strings.loc.item.ember_dial.lore: The scale is offset on purpose. Whoever made this knew that breaking the pattern could be useful.
strings.loc.item.ember_dial.name: Ember Dial
strings.loc.item.fracture_seal.lore: The last tool the Weavers used. The mark on it has been scratched out by hand.
strings.loc.item.fracture_seal.name: Fracture Seal
strings.loc.item.lumen_seed.lore: Warm, and heavier than it looks. The Loom made this when a pattern was complete. No Weaver ever saw one.
strings.loc.item.lumen_seed.name: Lumen Seed
strings.loc.item.memory_lens.lore: Cut from a crystal that had already remembered many states. It was made to compare pasts, not to find one.
strings.loc.item.memory_lens.name: Memory Lens
strings.loc.item.nox_harness.lore: Mira wove it from Archive Thread. The first thing anyone here has made instead of restored.
strings.loc.item.nox_harness.name: Nox Harness
strings.loc.item.prism_key.lore: Many faces. It fits its gate in only one state. Behind the gate is the one record the Weavers agreed on.
strings.loc.item.prism_key.name: Prism Key
strings.loc.item.quiet_coil.lore: Cut from the Engine when the Weavers stopped it. They kept a piece of the thing they feared.
strings.loc.item.quiet_coil.name: Quiet Coil
strings.loc.item.rootweave_gauntlet.lore: Grown, not made. The Archive shapes one for whoever reads its pattern.
strings.loc.item.rootweave_gauntlet.name: Rootweave Gauntlet
strings.loc.item.tuning_fork.lore: A working Weaver's everyday tool. Laid down neatly, with the others, and left.
strings.loc.item.tuning_fork.name: Tuning Fork
strings.loc.item.weaver_cube.lore: It is not the Loom. It speaks the Loom's language, close up. It was left here, not lost.
strings.loc.item.weaver_cube.name: The Cube
